messages:
Priya: Heads-up — my flight got delayed, won't make the 22:00-06:00 UTC primary shift. Can someone cover primary for that window? There's an ongoing P1 in EU (kv-cache evictions) but it's been stabilizing; I'll hand over notes below.

Eli: I can take primary 22:00-02:00 UTC. Marco, can you cover 02:00-06:00?

Marco: I can do 02:00-06:00 and be secondary the whole night if needed.

Priya: Quick status: P1 • kv-cache evictions, seen ~12% errors at peak, dropped to ~1.5% after throttles ~20m ago. No deploys in flight. Key metrics to watch: `kv-hit-rate`, `/v1/generate` error rate, and `edge.token_bucket_rejections`.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] P1 • kv-cache-evictions • affected: 3 customers • pager sent 21:12 UTC • assignee: Priya (acked 21:15 UTC) • status: monitoring.

Eli: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-evictions — quick steps to scale and mitigate. Quick commands in case you need them: 
```bash
rwdctl cache status --env prod --region eu
rwdctl cache scale --nodes 2
```

Sofia: If you escalate, ping SRE and include the last 15m of `kv-cache-*` metrics and the `model-serving` trace group.

Priya: Handoff notes: watch `/v1/generate` errors — threshold for escalation is >5% sustained over 5m. If that happens, rollback the most recent quantized variant (tagged `q2.1`) and scale cache nodes. Pager ref INC-4217.

Eli: I'll take primary 22:00-02:00 UTC. Adding to rotation calendar and PD.

Marco: I'll be secondary 22:00-06:00 UTC and will take over full primary if something blocks Eli. Confirmed.

Sofia: I'll be primary 02:00-06:00 UTC as planned. Acknowledged.

oncall-bot: Calendar update recorded — Primary: Eli (22:00-02:00 UTC); Primary: Sofia (02:00-06:00 UTC); Secondary: Marco (22:00-06:00 UTC). Handoff recorded by Priya at 21:48 UTC.

Marco: Pro tip — if scaling cache causes cost spikes, prefer raising `cache.eviction_threshold` to 0.8 first, or bump `cache.read_timeout` to 200ms as a short-term stopgap.

Priya: Leaving detailed notes: 
```text
- Mitigations done: applied edge token-bucket limiter 21:30 UTC
- No active rollouts or model swaps
- Watch: kv-hit-rate, edge.rejections, model-serving latency
- Pager ref: INC-4217
- Runbook: /runbooks/kv-cache-evictions
```

Eli: I'll monitor alerts and dashboards from 21:50. Ping here if anything before 22. :thumbsup: 

Sofia: I'll join the handoff at ~01:58 UTC to take context before 02:00.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled at 21:55 UTC for Eli to take over primary.

Eli: Ack.

Priya: Thanks all — appreciate the coverage. Leaving my pager open for 30m then switching to flight mode.
